title: Read and tick
text: A Read and tick

B Think and write
What do you think Bobby wrote about his mother?
My hero
My hero is my mother.
C Think and say
Who is your hero? Why? Share your ideas with your classmates.
Sounds in focus
1 Listen to the sentences from the story and read.
They work hard and do great things.
Thanks for taking my baby to the park yesterday.
2 Listen to the rhyme and chant along. Then find more words.
Great people are like stars.
In the dark, they give light.
With dreams and hard work,
You can also shine bright.
